description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of various emotional states, contextualized by the paper's focus on the evaluation of speaker anonymization on emotional speech. The chart is divided into a total of six slices. Each category is identified by a text label positioned just outside the pie, while the exact percentage is displayed directly inside each corresponding colored segment, meaning there is no separate legend. The largest segment is labeled "Frustration," colored cyan, representing 25.1% of the total. Adjacent to it is the "Neutral" category in purple, accounting for 23.1%. Continuing counter-clockwise from the Frustration slice, the chart displays "Anger" in yellow at 14.9%, "Sadness" in orange at 14.7%, "Excitement" in red at 14.1%, and finally "Happiness" in a medium blue at 8.1%. The segments do not appear to be arranged in a strict ascending or descending order by size. Additionally, none of the slices are visually emphasized, such as being exploded or offset from the main body of the chart.
